study_scope: Historical Class-I Senate diagnostic supporting, not replacing, the original E01 2026 forecasting workflow
feature_date_policy: Conservative first day after the documented FEC October 2019 publication month; not an observed precise release timestamp
selection_rule: All 33 regular Class-I statewide contests in the 2018 six-year-cycle official FEC table. Require exactly one named major-party Democratic candidate and one Republican in both regular general elections. No sampling by ratings, closeness, winner, margin, model error or forecast performance. Independent winners are not an exclusion: the target is explicitly D-R conditional two-party margin. Eligibility and official-source candidate/vote reconciliation are established before any error calculation. Any unresolved official discrepancy blocks evaluation instead of silently changing its denominator.
party_rule: Democrat includes state affiliates Democratic-Farmer-Labor (MN) and Democratic-NPL (ND); sum all fusion lines for the same named candidate, never count combined and separate totals twice. Nonmajor candidate votes are not reallocated.
geography_rule: Statewide constitutional Senate constituency, not House districts. Official FEC six-year Class-I table identifies prior seats; Senate official Class-I page identifies the 2024 cycle. Political state/seat identity is invariant for these elections; no tract/precinct spatial interpolation or House-map assumptions are used.
missing_or_bad_input: Block, no imputation. Party/ballot structural exclusions are logged before scoring. No one-vote sentinel rows from county tables are used; this pipeline uses statewide published candidate totals independently cross-checked to official sources.
metric: Macro MAE of signed (D-R)/(D+R)*100 vote margins, same exact eligible states for S_ZERO and S0; paired error differences and leave-one-state-out sensitivity, not universal superiority claims.
limitations: Post-hoc reconstruction: source retrieval and sample freeze occur after the 2024 election; not a historically untouched holdout or prospective forecast
No inference about 2026 performance or agent value
No model calls or agent variants run
The D-R conditional target can exclude an independent winner's votes and is not winner probability
Retrospective official results establish participant identity but are not pre-election archived ballots
Statewide Senate constituency checks do not validate House district maps
